title: Netflix Shares Major Jujutsu Kaisen Update Ahead of Season 4
content: 2026 kicked off with the exciting Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Part 1, which features the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident Arc before commencing the Culling Game. Following the flashback arc in Season 2, which features Satoru Gojo, the anime follows the brutal battle in Shibuya.
author: ComicBook

title: Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Anime Reveals Cast Members for Oni Brigade
content: The staff of the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc television anime based on Yura Urushibara 's Tougen Anki: Dark Demon of Paradise manga revealed a new visual and cast members for the anime on Thursday. All the new cast members play characters from the Oni Brigade.
author: ANN

title: Star Wars Kicks Off New Jedi Era With New Anime Series Trailer – Watch Now
content: Star Wars is going to be hitting Disney+ later this Summer with its first full anime series, and now fans have gotten the release date for the new project ahead of its premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: MyAnimeList Reports from Anime Expo 2026
content: Anime Expo , the largest anime convention in North America, returns to Los Angeles Convention Center and will be held July 2–5 this year. MAL users and moderators have attended Anime Expo for years, and our team will once again provide live updates from the event this year.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Solo Leveling Returns With Its Darkest New Story Ahead of Anime Sequel
content: The wait for Solo Leveling Season 3 is longer than ever as the animation studio remains silent on the highly anticipated sequel. The second season of the anime reached its conclusion last year, but the anime hasn’t been officially renewed for a third season.
author: ComicBook

title: Grow Up Show -Sunflower Circus- Anime's English Trailer Reveals Cast, Same-Day English Dub
content: Aniplex of America unveiled during its panel at Anime Expo on Thursday an English-dubbed trailer for Aniplex , A-1 Pictures , and Psyde Kick Studio 's original anime project Grow Up Show: Sunflower Circus - ( Grow Up Show: Himawari no Circus-dan ).
author: ANN

title: Eleceed TV Anime Reveals Main Cast in 1st Promo Video
content: Amuse Creative Studio revealed on Friday the main voice cast and first promotional video for the television anime adaptation of author Jeho Son and artist ZHENA webtoon series ELECEED .
author: ANN

title: Kodansha USA Announces Print Releases for Phoenix, Witch Hat Atelier: Special Stories, Historié, Fatale Game, More Manga
content: Kodansha USA Publishing announced during its Anime Expo panel on Thursday new print releases for spring 2026: Meanwhile, inside one of these buildings, someone is committing a savage and inexplicable murder.
author: ANN

title: 'Mashle: Sanma Taisou Shinkakusha Saishuu Shiken-hen' Unveils Production Staff, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The Aniplex of America Industry Panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed the production staff and a teaser promotional video for the third season of the Mashle ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles ) television anime on Thursday. The new season is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
